Statement of matter in dispute
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mrs.S.Pushparani who worked at the St. Vincenti Home has been deprived of her employment in accordance with the statement made by her that her employment has been suspended and if so, to what relief she is entitled.
